verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe a `logseq://` protocol that lets third-party apps invoke actions in Logseq, including `x-callback-url/quickCapture`, which can be bookmarked in a browser or opened from the command line. Docs also describe a local HTTP APIs server, enabled under Features, that gives authorized external access to the graph. Together these cover the core of scripting the app from outside. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of deep links that open a specific page or block, detailed documentation of which HTTP API endpoints can create or open notes, and independent or hands-on corroboration that these integrations work.
